title: Raudonė Castle
scope: The standing red-brick castle, comprising the three connected wings, open west-facing courtyard, 33.5-metre observation tower, and all five lesser round turrets.
limitations: Minor roof slopes, decorative brick divisions and elevations beyond the two source views are reconstructed at the fidelity appropriate for Earth view.
The model covers the castle proper. The separate granary, mill and estate park are outside its footprint.
